snippet.title: Dramatour - Official Launch trailer
snippet.description:
Dramatour is launching May 28 2026 on Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3908710/Dramatour/

In this local split-screen multiplayer game, 2-4 players compete to build the tallest tower by stacking randomly selected 3D objects.

Inspired by a low poly universe with circus, theater and carnival influences, the game combines strategic construction and dynamic confrontation: players can either place their objects to stabilize their tower, or throw them at their opponent's to destabilize it.

Based on a realistic physics system, the game does not artificially detect collapses, letting gravity and tower stability determine the outcome of each game. With no time limit, it offers a competitive and immersive experience, promoting strategy and skill in a unique visual and audio environment.
